validity.details: P6710 is a real, now-completed gas pipeline (a 160 km газопровод-отвод/branch line off the trunk system, per ulus.media and gtrksakha.ru, both calling it a 'магистральный газопровод' / 'газопровод-отвод') running from the Srednetyungskoye gas-condensate field (Vilyuysky District, Sakha Republic) to the Nakynskoye diamond ore field (Nyurbinsky District, Sakha Republic), built by Sakhatransneftegaz JSC as general contractor for ALROSA subsidiary Yakutskaya Generating Company LLC. Corroborated across a five-stage documentary trail: 2021 SPIEF agreement announcement (eastrussia.ru) -> Oct 12 2023 construction start (ulus.media + gtrksakha.ru + eastrussia.ru, three independent dated sources agreeing on the exact date) -> Jan 2025 (Sakhatransneftegaz's own press site, aostng.ru, via Wayback) -> March 2025 85km-progress update (gtrksakha.ru) -> July 2025 near-completion (nedradv.ru) -> Dec 24 2025 formal commissioning (Republic of Sakha government press service, reprinted by neftegaz.ru/1sn.ru/yakutia24.ru, independently reconfirmed a day later by Sakhatransneftegaz's own press channel via sakhapress.ru). Checked against the other 31 rows on this batch's Far Eastern roster (esp. other Sakha/Yakutia feeder lines such as P3896 Kysyl-Syr-Ayan and P6690/P6691/P6695): none describes this same Srednetyungskoye-to-Nakyn route under another name -- confirmed as a singleton, not a duplicate/relabel. PipelineType=transmission is correct: ulus.media explicitly calls it 'магистрального газопровода' (trunk/transmission gas pipeline) as distinct from a field-internal gathering network.
validity.recommended_action: No action beyond the fills staged below.

validity.summary: Capacity recorded as 0.03 bcm/y (30 million m3/y) conflicts with 0.02 bcm/y (20 million m3/y) stated in the official Dec 2025 commissioning announcement -- two genuinely different, differently-dated origins disagree.
validity.details: nedradv.ru (28 Jul 2025, ALROSA-sourced, pre-completion progress report) states 'Объем поставки газа составит около 30 млн кубометров в год' (~30 million m3/year = 0.03 bcm/y, matching the sheet exactly). The Dec 24 2025 official commissioning announcement (Republic of Sakha government press service, reprinted verbatim by neftegaz.ru/1sn.ru/yakutia24.ru -- one origin, three outlets) states gas supply 'для алмазодобытчиков составит около 20 млн кубометров' (~20 million m3/year = 0.02 bcm/y). Conversion shown: 20 million m3/y x 0.001 = 0.02 bcm/y; 30 million m3/y x 0.001 = 0.03 bcm/y. These are not a rounding variant of each other -- a genuine one-third change in stated volume. The Dec 2025 figure is post-completion/at-launch and more likely to reflect the as-commissioned design capacity; the Jul 2025 nedradv figure is a pre-completion estimate. Recommending the later, post-completion, government-sourced figure (0.02 bcm/y) as the update, but flagging this explicitly as a real, unresolved-to-certainty conflict rather than silently picking one.
validity.recommended_action: Propose changing Capacity to 0.02 bcm/y (Dec 2025 commissioning figure); note the superseded 0.03 bcm/y (Jul 2025 estimate) in ResearcherNotes rather than deleting it.

validity.summary: Owner1='Sakhatransneftegaz JSC' 100% may conflate contractor with owner -- two neftegazpro.ru trade-construction articles identify ALROSA subsidiary 'Yakutskaya Generating Company LLC' (OOO «Yakutskaya generiruyushchaya kompaniya») as the project's Zakazchik (customer/client), with Sakhatransneftegaz JSC named explicitly as Generalny podryadchik (general contractor) only.
validity.details: Both neftegazpro.ru articles (same publisher, so one independent origin) carry a structured project-data block: 'Zakazchik [Customer] -- ...docherniaya kompaniya ALROSA -- OOO «Yakutskaya generiruyushchaya kompaniya» Respublika Sakha' and 'General'niy podryadchik [General Contractor] -- AO «Sakhatransneftegaz»'. In Russian infrastructure practice, the Zakazchik (project customer/client commissioning the build) is not automatically the final registered asset owner -- and every OTHER source in this research (gtrksakha.ru, neftegaz.ru, sakhapress.ru, aostng.ru itself) consistently describes Sakhatransneftegaz as the party building AND (via its own press channel) reporting the pipeline's progress/completion as its own project, consistent with Sakhatransneftegaz being both Operator (uncontested, MISSING_REF filled below) and, plausibly, the registered Owner once complete (a common Russian-gas-utility pattern: a regional gas company builds branch/feeder lines for a client's demand and then owns/operates the resulting network asset). No source found states Owner1 in those terms explicitly (no source uses the Russian word 'sobstvennik'/owner for either party) -- this is a genuine open attribution question, not a confirmed error. NOT changing Owner1 without stronger direct evidence; the sheet's existing Owner [ref] citation to interfax.com/newsroom/top-stories/103115/ is confirmed off-topic (that article is about a separate ALROSA/Sakhatransneftegaz oil-and-gas EXPLORATION license joint venture, not this pipeline or its ownership) and has been dropped.
validity.recommended_action: Keep Owner1='Sakhatransneftegaz JSC' 100% as recorded (best available evidence, though not conclusively proven) but flag for a future pass with access to a Rosreestr asset registry or a direct company disclosure naming the registered owner of the completed Nakynsky Potok line.
